englishDefinition: A person who writes news stories for newspapers, magazines, or online media.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make a fire start burning, or to cause a feeling such as interest to begin.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The man who rules a country that has a royal family, and who is the head of that family.

englishDefinition: All the visible features of an area of land, including hills, fields, and buildings.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

examplePersian: نویسنده برای توصیف اثر تورم بر خانواده‌ها استعاره‌ای نیرومند به کار می‌برد.

englishDefinition: Very quick and sudden in its rise to success, and often not lasting long.
example: His meteoric rise in the industry ended in scandal within three years.
examplePersian: صعود ناگهانی او در این صنعت ظرف سه سال به رسوایی انجامید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The scientific study of the weather, and of the conditions that produce it.
example: Meteorology departments use radar and satellites to predict violent storms.
examplePersian: اداره‌های هواشناسی با رادار و ماهواره طوفان‌های شدید را پیش‌بینی می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A particular way of doing something, or of reaching a result.
example: The method used in the study is simple, but the results are reliable.
examplePersian: روش به‌کاررفته در این پژوهش ساده است، اما نتایج آن قابل اتکاست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The different ways of doing a piece of work, or of reaching a result.
example: The company changed its safety methods after the inspectors found a fault.
examplePersian: شرکت پس از آنکه بازرسان نقصی یافتند، روش‌های ایمنی خود را تغییر داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extremely careful about small details, so that nothing is done wrongly or missed.
example: The building was restored over eight years with meticulous attention to detail.
examplePersian: بنایشان طی هشت سال با دقتی وسواسی نسبت به جزئیات بازسازی شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A number that is used in order to measure or compare something.
example: The company reports its progress by the metric of profit rather than of safety.
examplePersian: شرکت پیشرفت خود را با معیار سود به‌جای ایمنی گزارش می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Connected with a large city, or belonging to the area around a very large city.
example: The metropolitan area holds half the country's population but very few jobs.
examplePersian: ناحیهٔ مترپولیتانی نیمی از جمعیت کشور را در خود جای داده اما شغل اندکی دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very small living thing, such as a bacterium, that cannot be seen without a microscope.
example: Washing your hands kills most of the microbes that cause infection.
examplePersian: شستن دست‌ها بیشتر میکروب‌هایی را که عفونت ایجاد می‌کنند از بین می‌برد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The scientific study of very small living things, such as bacteria and viruses.
example: She specialised in microbiology and now studies harmful bacteria in food.
examplePersian: او در میکروبیولوژی تخصص گرفت و اکنون باکتری‌های مضر در غذا را مطالعه می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very small world in which the larger whole is represented, like a small model of it.
example: The island is a microcosm of the whole country's problems.
examplePersian: این جزیره نمونهٔ کوچکی از مشکلات کل کشور است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A thin sheet of film on which very small photographs of the pages of a book are recorded.
example: Old newspapers can be read on microfilm in the national library.
examplePersian: روزنامه‌های قدیمی را می‌توان در کتابخانهٔ ملی روی میکروفیلم خواند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A device that picks up a speaker's voice and makes it louder so that others can hear it.
example: Please move a little closer if the microphone cannot hear you.
examplePersian: اگر میکروفون صدای شما را نمی‌شنود، لطفاً کمی نزدیک‌تر شوید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: In the middle of a period of time, or between two points in a series.
example: The shop closes for a week in mid-August, when most people are away.
examplePersian: این مغازه در اواسط مرداد که بیشتر مردم در تعطیلات هستند یک هفته تعطیل است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The time in the morning around ten or eleven o'clock, after the early rush is over.
example: The shops reopen for the sale in midmorning and sell out by noon.
examplePersian: فروشگاه‌ها اواسط صبح برای حراج باز می‌شوند و تا ظهر موجودی‌شان تمام می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The time at the end of the day when it is twelve o'clock at night.
example: Trains stop running at midnight, so the last bus is the only option.
examplePersian: قطارها نیمه‌شب حرکت می‌کنند، بنابراین آخرین اتوبوس تنها گزینه است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Used to say that something is possible but not certain, or to make a polite request.
example: Without more money the project might not be finished on time.
examplePersian: بدون پول بیشتر ممکن است پروژه به‌موقع تمام نشود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Very powerful, or extremely large and impressive in force.
example: The mighty river flooded three villages in a single night.
examplePersian: رود نیرومند در یک شب سه روستا را سیلاب گرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To move from one country, region, or place to another in order to live or work there.
example: Many young workers migrate to the capital in search of better pay.
examplePersian: بسیاری از کارگران جوان برای یافتن دستمزد بهتر به پایتخت مهاجرت می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The movement of people or animals from one country or region to another.
example: Migration towards the cities has emptied many small villages.
examplePersian: مهاجرت به سوی شهرها بسیاری از روستاهای کوچک را خالی کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Moving from one place to another each year, as birds and many fish do.
example: Migratory birds arrive at the wetland every spring to lay their eggs.
examplePersian: پرندگان مهاجر هر بهار برای تخم‌گذاری به تالاب می‌رسند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A soft grey or green growth that appears on damp walls, food, or cloth.
example: Damp walls and a broken window have left a patch of mildew in the room.
examplePersian: دیوارهای نمناک و پنجرهٔ شکسته لکه‌ای از کپک در اتاق به‌جای گذاشته‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The distance travelled, measured in miles, especially when you compare vehicles.
example: More mileage means more wear, so check the odometer before you buy.
examplePersian: پیمایش بیشتر یعنی فرسودگی بیشتر، بنابراین پیش از خرید کیلومترشمار را ببینید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The plural of mile, a unit of distance equal to about one and a half kilometres.
example: The village is three miles from the station and has no bus service.
examplePersian: این روستا سه مایل با ایستگاه فاصله دارد و سرویس اتوبوس ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Aggressive in support of a political aim, and ready to use violence.
example: The militant group refused to talk and warned of further attacks.
examplePersian: گروه مسلحانه و رادیکال از مذاکره سر باز زد و دربارهٔ حملات بیشتر هشدار داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The white liquid that comes from cows and goats, and is a common drink and food.
example: The café sells milk, soya drinks, and coffee from local farms.
examplePersian: کافه شیر، نوشیدنی سویا و قهوهٔ مزرعه‌های محلی را می‌فروشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A period of one thousand years, or the end of one thousand years.
example: The building was used as a warehouse for most of the last millennium.
examplePersian: این بنا در بیشتر هزارهٔ گذشته به‌عنوان انبار استفاده می‌شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The number equal to one thousand thousand, that is 1,000,000.
example: The charity claims to feed more than two million children every year.
examplePersian: این خیریه ادعا می‌کند هر سال بیش از دو میلیون کودک را تغذیه می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Buildings or machines that grind grain into flour.
example: Old flour mills along the river have been converted into museums.
examplePersian: آسیاب‌های آرد قدیمی در کنار رودخانه به موزه تبدیل شده‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To copy the way somebody speaks or acts, usually in order to make fun of them.
example: The parrot was able to mimic the sound of a human voice.
examplePersian: طوطی می‌توانست صدای انسان را تقلید کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The part of a person that thinks, feels, and makes decisions.
example: Learning a language exercises both the mind and the memory.
examplePersian: یادگیری زبان هم ذهن و هم حافظه را به کار می‌گیرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A deep opening in the ground from which coal, metal, or gems are taken out.
example: The mine employs three hundred workers and produces coal for the whole country.
examplePersian: این معدن سیصد کارگر به کار می‌گیرد و برای کل کشور زغال‌سنگ تولید می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To move among people in a relaxed way, talking to different people.
example: Guests were invited to mingle and talk about the exhibition.
examplePersian: مهمانان دعوت شدند در جمع بگردند و دربارهٔ نمایشگاه گفت‌وگو کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very small in amount, size, or importance.
example: The damage was minimal, and the building stayed open the whole time.
examplePersian: خسارت بسیار اندک بود و ساختمان در تمام مدت باز ماند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The smallest amount, number, or level that must be accepted.
example: Applicants need a minimum of two years of teaching experience.
examplePersian: متقاضیان حداقل دو سال سابقهٔ تدریس نیاز دارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The industry and the work of taking coal, metals, or minerals out of the ground.
example: Mining has provided most of the jobs in this valley for a century.
examplePersian: معدن‌کاری بیش از یک قرن بیشتر مشاغل این دره را فراهم کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A senior member of a government who is responsible for one area, such as education.
example: The minister for health announced a new plan for rural clinics.
examplePersian: وزیر بهداشت طرح تازه‌ای برای درمانگاه‌های روستایی اعلام کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The smaller number of people in a group, when a much larger group exists.
example: Only a small minority of pupils failed the examination last year.
examplePersian: تنها اقلیت کوچکی از دانش‌آموزان سال گذشته در آزمون مردود شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A plant with small green leaves that is added to food and drinks to give a fresh taste.
example: The waiter brought mint tea with the meal at no extra charge.
examplePersian: پیشخدمت همراه غذا چای نعناع را بدون هزینهٔ اضافه آورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Used in the calculation of a number to show that it should be taken away.
example: The final score was thirty minus five, so twenty-five goals were scored.
examplePersian: نتیجهٔ نهایی سی منهای پنج بود، بنابراین بیست‌وپنج گل زده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Sixty seconds, which is the shortest unit of time used for ordinary purposes.
example: The walk takes ten minutes if the weather stays dry.
examplePersian: اگر هوا خشک بماند، پیاده‌روی ده دقیقه طول می‌کشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The written record of what was said and decided at a formal meeting.
example: The minutes of the last meeting have not been published yet.
examplePersian: صورت‌جلسهٔ آخرین نشست هنوز منتشر نشده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An event that seems impossible and is therefore regarded as a special gift from God.
example: The doctors called her recovery a miracle, since the damage had been so severe.
examplePersian: پزشکان بهبود او را معجزه خواندند، زیرا آسیب بسیار شدید بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An image of distant water or land that appears in hot air and then disappears.
example: The drivers followed a mirage across the flat desert for several hours.
examplePersian: رانندگان ساعت‌ها سرابی را در بیابان هموار دنبال کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An area of soft wet ground, such as deep mud, that is hard to walk through.
example: After a week of rain the lane became a mire and the vans could not pass.
examplePersian: پس از یک هفته باران، کوچه به گل و مرداب تبدیل شد و کامیون‌ها نتوانستند عبور کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The loss of a baby before it is born, or the failure of a plan or process.
example: The clinic offers counselling after a miscarriage to help mothers recover.
examplePersian: کلینیک پس از سقط جنین مشاوره ارائه می‌دهد تا به مادران کمک کند بهبود یابند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An unlucky accident that happens by chance, rather than because of anybody's fault.
example: By pure mischance the letter was posted to the wrong street.
examplePersian: کاملاً بر اثر بدشانسی، نامه به خیابان اشتباه پست شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Fun that children get from doing something that annoys or puzzles other people.
example: The puppy got into the kitchen and caused a lot of mischief.
examplePersian: توله‌سگ وارد آشپزخانه شد و شرارت زیادی به بار آورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To have a wrong idea about something, or to misunderstand what somebody means.
example: Many people misconceive the study and think that it is a waste of time.
examplePersian: بسیاری از مردم این پژوهش را بد فهمیده و گمان می‌کنند که هدر دادن وقت است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An action that is wrong or illegal, especially one that is quite serious.
example: The manager was dismissed for several serious misdeeds during his time in charge.
examplePersian: مدیر به‌دلیل چند کردار زشت جدی در دوران مسئولیتش برکنار شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extremely unhappy, or so poor in quality that it makes somebody deeply dissatisfied.
example: The weather was miserable, so the whole trip was spent indoors.
examplePersian: هوا رقت‌انگیز بود، بنابراین تمام سفر در داخل خانه گذشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Great unhappiness, or a condition of great physical or mental pain.
example: Years of civil war left the country in a state of misery.
examplePersian: سال‌ها جنگ داخلی کشور را در حال بدبختی و رنج باقی گذاشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A bad event that happens to somebody, often because of bad luck rather than any cause.
example: He lost his job through misfortune rather than through any fault of his own.
examplePersian: او شغلش را از روی بدبختی از دست داد، نه به سبب تقصیر خودش.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A feeling of worry or doubt that something may turn out badly.
example: She had serious misgivings about signing the contract without advice.
examplePersian: او دربارهٔ امضای قرارداد بدون مشورت نگرانی جدی داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An accident or small problem that is not serious and does not last long.
example: The delayed flight was a minor mishap compared with the storm.
examplePersian: تأخیر پرواز در مقایسه با طوفان حادثهٔ کوچکی بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To describe something wrongly, so that people form a false idea about it.
example: The advertisement misrepresents the cost of the course to new students.
examplePersian: این آگهی هزینهٔ دوره را برای دانشجویان تازه بد جلوه می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A weapon that is fired into the air in order to destroy a target far away.
example: The missile was launched from the coast early on Thursday morning.
examplePersian: موشک بامداد پنج‌شنبه از ساحل شلیک شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A particular job that somebody is sent away to do, or a group sent for a purpose.
example: The government sent a mission to study the damage caused by the earthquake.
examplePersian: دولت هیئتی فرستاد تا خسارت واردشده بر اثر زلزله را بررسی کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A cloud of very small water drops that makes the air hard to see through.
example: Early morning mist covered the road and slowed the early traffic.
examplePersian: مه صبحگاهی جاده را پوشانده بود و ترافیک ساعت اول را کند کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The use of something in a way that it was never intended for, or that is not allowed.
example: The misuse of public money led to several arrests in the city.
examplePersian: سوءاستفاده از پول عمومی به چند بازداشت در شهر منجر شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make a bad situation, its effect, or its pain less serious.
example: Planting trees along the road can mitigate the effects of the flooding.
examplePersian: کاشت درخت در امتداد جاده می‌تواند اثر سیلاب را کاهش دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A combination of two or more different things that are put together.
example: The sauce is a mixture of honey, lemon, and a little garlic.
examplePersian: سویس مخلوطی از عسل، لیمو و کمی سیر است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Able to move or to be moved easily, rather than fixed in one place.
example: Most customers now use a mobile app to book and pay for their tickets.
examplePersian: بیشتر مشتریان اکنون برای رزرو و پرداخت بلیت از یک برنامهٔ قابل حمل استفاده می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To bring people together so that they work together on a job, task, or cause.
example: The charity mobilized thousands of volunteers after the floods began.
examplePersian: خیریه پس از آغاز سیل هزاران داوطلب را بسیج کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make fun of somebody by copying their voice or behaviour in an unkind way.

englishDefinition: A lasting change in the form or in the genetic material of a living thing.

examplePersian: دانشمندان اکنون می‌توانند جهشی را که این بیماری نادر را ایجاد می‌کند شناسایی کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To speak in a low voice that is not clear, usually because you are angry or unhappy.
example: He muttered something about the delay and walked out of the room.
examplePersian: او دربارهٔ تأخیر چیزی غریبند زد و از اتاق بیرون رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Shared or felt by two or more people in the same way, or done towards each other.
example: The deal was a great success, and both sides claimed mutual benefit.
examplePersian: این توافق بزرگ موفقیت بود و هر دو طرف منفعت متقابل را ادعا کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A very large number of separate things, too many to be counted one by one.
example: The forest supports a myriad of insects, birds, and small plants.
examplePersian: این جنگل بیشمار حشره، پرنده و گیاه کوچک را پشتیبانی می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A traditional story that people believe explains the world but that cannot be proved.
example: The idea that the city was built by giants is now regarded as a myth.
examplePersian: این پندار که شهر را غولان ساخته‌اند، اکنون باوری نادرست شمرده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The collection of old stories about gods and heroes that explains a culture's beliefs.
example: The course studies Greek mythology through its most famous stories.
examplePersian: این درس اساطیر یونانی را از طریق مشهورترین داستان‌هایش مطالعه می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not wearing any clothes, or without any covering or decoration.
example: The heat was so strong that workers slept naked on the roofs.
examplePersian: گرما آن‌قدر شدید بود که کارگران روی بام‌ها برهنه می‌خوابیدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Used to introduce the specific names or details of what has just been mentioned.
example: Three officials were dismissed, namely the head of roads and two engineers.
examplePersian: سه مقام برکنار شدند، یعنی رئیس راهداری و دو مهندس.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A short period of sleep during the day, usually taken in the afternoon.
example: She always takes a short nap after lunch and feels much better afterwards.
examplePersian: او همیشه بعد از ناهار یک چرت کوتاه می‌گیرد و پس از آن خیلی بهتر احساس می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A strong drug that makes a person sleepy and relaxed, and that is hard to give up.
example: The doctor gave him a mild narcotic to ease the pain after the operation.
examplePersian: پزشک برای تسکین درد پس از عمل جراحی مخدری ملایم به او داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The story that a book, film, or speaker tells, and the order in which events are given.
example: The report begins with a narrative of the events of that winter.
examplePersian: گزارش با روایتی از رویدادهای آن زمستان آغاز می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The person who tells a story, or whose voice reads a book aloud.
example: The narrator of the film is a journalist who lived through the event.
examplePersian: راوی فیلم روزنامه‌نگاری است که آن رویداد را از نزدیک تجربه کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Unpleasant to look at, to smell, or to experience, and often painful as well.
example: The medicine had a nasty taste, but it cured the infection in three days.
examplePersian: دارو طعمی بد داشت، اما ظرف سه روز عفونت را درمان کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Connected with birth, or with the birth of a particular child.
example: The clinic records every natal case separately, so the figures are reliable.
examplePersian: کلینیک هر مورد زایمان را جداگانه ثبت می‌کند، بنابراین آمار دقیق است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Belonging to a whole country rather than to one town, region, or group.
example: The country has no national standard for labelling packaged food.
examplePersian: این کشور برای برچسب‌گذاری غذای بسته‌بندی‌شده استاندارد ملی ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The different groups of people, defined by the country or nation they belong to.
example: People of all nationalities live together in this border town.
examplePersian: مردم از همهٔ ملیت‌ها در این شهر مرزی با هم زندگی می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The country or nation that a person belongs to as a citizen.
example: The form asks for your nationality, your age, and your address.
examplePersian: این فرم ملیت، سن و نشانی شما را می‌پرسد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Born in a particular country or place, rather than having come there to live.
example: A native guide can explain the history of the building far better.
examplePersian: یک راهنمای بومی می‌تواند تاریخ ساختمان را به‌مراتب بهتر توضیح دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Existing in nature, or produced by natural processes rather than by people.
example: The wool in this coat is natural, so it keeps you warm even when it is wet.
examplePersian: پشم این پالتو طبیعی است، بنابراین حتی وقتی خیس شوید شما را گرم نگه می‌دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The physical world, and all the plants, animals, and land that form it.
example: The reserve protects rare plants and gives the forest back to nature.
examplePersian: این منطقهٔ حفاظت‌شده از گیاهان نادر محافظت می‌کند و جنگل را به طبیعت بازمی‌گرداند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Nothing at all, used in written English when a zero appears in front of another number.
example: The score was naught to nothing, and the match ended early.
examplePersian: نتیجه هیچ به هیچ بود و مسابقه زودتر پایان یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A sick feeling in the stomach that comes just before you may vomit.
example: Strong smells in the workshop caused nausea among the workers.
examplePersian: بوهای تند در کارگاه باعث تهوع کارگران شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Connected with ships and sailing, or with the skills needed to work at sea.
example: The course teaches nautical skills that are hard to learn on shore.
examplePersian: این درس مهارت‌های دریانوردی را می‌آموزد که آموختنشان در خشکی دشوار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Belonging to a navy, or connected with ships and with fighting at sea.
example: Naval spending fell after the country decided to build smaller ships.
examplePersian: پس از تصمیم کشور برای ساخت کشتی‌های کوچک‌تر، هزینه‌های نیروی دریایی کاهش یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Wide and deep enough for boats to travel along safely.
example: The river is navigable for most of its length up to the hills.
examplePersian: رودخانه در بیشتر طول خود تا کوهستان برای تردد قابل کشت است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The skill or the business of finding the right route to travel by sea or by air.
example: Navigation through the ice is difficult for six weeks of the year.
examplePersian: ناوبری میان یخ برای شش هفته از سال دشوار است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Arranged in a tidy way, or done in a clever and skilful way.
example: The kitchen was surprisingly neat although three children live there.
examplePersian: با وجود اینکه سه کودک آنجا زندگی می‌کنند، آشپزخانه به‌طرز تعجب‌آوری مرتب بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make something necessary, because the situation cannot be dealt with otherwise.
example: The shortage of fuel necessitated changes to the whole timetable.
examplePersian: کمبود سوخت تغییراتی را در کل جدول زمانی ایجاب کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The part of the body that joins the head to the shoulders.
example: She had a stiff neck after sleeping on the train all night.
examplePersian: او پس از خوابیدن تمام شب روی قطار گردن خشکی پیدا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The action of denying that something is true, or of saying that it does not exist.
example: The report is not a simple negation of everything the critics said.
examplePersian: این گزارش نفی سادهٔ همهٔ سخنان منتقدان نیست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Saying that something is not true, or showing that something bad has happened.
example: The test gave a negative result, so the doctor said nothing was wrong.
examplePersian: آزمایش نتیجهٔ منفی داد، بنابراین پزشک گفت مشکلی وجود ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The failure to give somebody or something the care or attention that it needs.
example: Years of neglect left the building in a very poor condition.
examplePersian: سال‌ها بی‌توجهی ساختمان را در وضعیت بسیار بدی رها کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Careless behaviour that results in damage, illness, or an accident.
example: The fire was started by the negligence of two maintenance workers.
examplePersian: آتش با بی‌احتیاطی دو کارگر تعمیرات آغاز شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: So small that it does not matter and can safely be ignored.
example: The difference between the two samples is negligible.
examplePersian: تفاوت میان دو نمونه ناچیز و قابل چشم‌پوشی است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Able to be changed by discussion, so that the two sides can agree on it.
example: The final price was negotiable, and it fell after three meetings.
examplePersian: قیمت نهایی قابل مذاکره بود و پس از سه جلسه کاهش یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Near and next to something, in the same area or on the same street.
example: Neighboring countries have agreed to share information on air quality.
examplePersian: کشورهای همسایه توافق کرده‌اند اطلاعات کیفیت هوا را به اشتراک بگذارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Anxious and afraid, especially about something that is about to happen.
example: Candidates are usually nervous before a first job interview.
examplePersian: داوطلبان پیش از نخستین مصاحبهٔ شغلی معمولاً مضطرب هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Open frames of rope or wire that are used to catch fish, birds, or insects.
example: The fishermen mended their nets on the shore before the tide turned.
examplePersian: ماهیگیران پیش از برگشت جزر، تورهایشان را در ساحل تعمیر کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A group of people or things that are connected with each other, or linked machines.
example: A good transport network makes it easy to live far from the office.
examplePersian: شبکهٔ حمل‌ونقل خوب زندگی دور از دفتر کار را آسان می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A long-lasting anxiety disorder in which a person feels fear for no clear reason.
example: She was treated for a mild neurosis that left her unable to work.
examplePersian: او برای نوروزی خفیف درمان شد که او را از کار بازداشته بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Very anxious and worried in a way that is stronger than the situation deserves.
example: Neurotic spending on unneeded insurance is common among new drivers.
examplePersian: هزینهٔ نورووتیک روی بیمه‌های غیرضروری میان رانندگان تازه رایج است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make something harmless or ineffective, so that it can no longer cause harm.
example: A simple wet cloth will neutralize the acid on your skin.
examplePersian: یک پارچهٔ نمدار ساده اسید روی پوست را خنثی می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Used to say that a surprising result holds true in spite of something else.
example: The road was narrow; nevertheless, the buses drove along it daily.
examplePersian: جاده باریک بود؛ با این حال اتوبوس‌ها هر روز از آن عبور می‌کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Printed sheets of news that are published every day, in the morning or the afternoon.
example: He read the whole newspaper before leaving the house in the morning.
examplePersian: او پیش از بیرون رفتن از خانه در صبح، تمام روزنامه را خواند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Printed publications that come out regularly and that carry news and articles.
example: People who read newspapers daily tend to follow world news more closely.
examplePersian: کسانی که هر روز روزنامه می‌خوانند معمولاً اخبار جهان را دقیق‌تر دنبال می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To bite small pieces from something slowly, a little at a time.
example: She nibbled at the bread for an hour without really eating it.
examplePersian: او یک ساعت بی‌آنکه واقعاً بخورد، گازهای کوچکی از نان می‌زد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very small detail of behaviour or language that shows careful social judgement.
example: Diplomats are trained to observe every nicety of social behaviour.
examplePersian: دیپلمات‌ها آموزش می‌بینند تا هر ظرافت رفتار اجتماعی را بسنجند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A grey metal used in coins and in steel, and that resists rust very well.
example: Nickel is one of the metals used to make the strongest steel alloys.
examplePersian: نیکل یکی از فلزهایی است که در ساخت آلیاژهای فولادی بسیار مقاوم به کار می‌رود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The dark period of time between sunset and sunrise, when most people sleep.
example: The temperature falls so fast at night that the pond freezes at the edges.
examplePersian: دما در شب چنان سریع افت می‌کند که لبه‌های حوضچه یخ می‌زند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A frightening dream, or a very bad situation that is hard to get out of.
example: The factory closure was a nightmare for everyone who worked there.
examplePersian: تعطیلی کارخانه برای هر کسی که آنجا کار می‌کرد کابوس بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Nothing, or a total of zero, used especially in the reporting of scores.
example: Three teams arrived, but the number of goals scored was nil.
examplePersian: سه تیم رسیدند، اما تعداد گل‌های زده‌شده صفر بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The gas that makes up most of the air, and that all living things need.
example: Farmers add nitrogen to the soil because the crops take it out.
examplePersian: کشاورزان نیتروژن به خاک می‌افزایند چون محصولات آن را جذب می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The quality of being noble in character, together with high social rank.
example: Her courage in the flood won admiration and a strange kind of nobility.
examplePersian: شجاعت او در سیلاب، تحسین و نوعی نیکی خاص را به دست آورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Good and generous in a way that earns respect, or connected with the highest social rank.
example: She made a noble attempt to keep the library open all winter.
examplePersian: او تلاشی بزرگوارانه کرد تا کتابخانه را تمام زمستان باز نگه دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A loud or unpleasant sound, or the general amount of sound in a place.
example: The noise from the new road makes the back bedrooms hard to sleep in.
examplePersian: سر و صدای جادهٔ تازه خوابیدن در اتاق‌های پشتی را دشوار می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Making a lot of noise, or full of noise and activity.
example: The flat above is noisy, so we sleep with the windows shut.
examplePersian: آپارتمان بالا پرسروصداست، بنابراین با پنجره‌های بسته می‌خوابیم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution
